title: Jesse's interview with Puthoff and Weinstein on remote viewing

tellings.quote: It's funny he was touching on it in my interview with him and Eric Weinstein

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he once interviewed a researcher, Hal Puthoff, together with another researcher, Eric Weinstein. He says the subject of remote viewing came up in that talk. Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe faraway places or objects using only the mind. He brings it up as a sign that serious researchers are willing to discuss the idea.
